# Light Speed Ghost

> The AI academic writing and publishing platform built for students and creators. Eight dedicated tools. Real peer-reviewed citations. No Wikipedia.

## What it is

Light Speed Ghost (lightspeedghost.com) is an AI-powered academic writing and publishing platform for college and university students. It combines eight specialized tools in one platform: AI paper writing, outline generation, paper revision, LightSpeed Humanizer (AI text rewriting), AI and plagiarism detection, STEM problem solving, a long-term memory AI study assistant, and an AI ebook writer for publishing to Amazon KDP and 40+ platforms.

It is available at [lightspeedghost.com](https://lightspeedghost.com) and works in any modern browser with no installation required. Also available as a PWA (installable on iOS, Android, and desktop).

## Who it is for

- Undergraduate and postgraduate students at any university worldwide
- Students writing essays, research papers, lab reports, literature reviews, dissertations, and theses
- Students in STEM subjects who need step-by-step homework help with equations and graphs
- Anyone checking their work for AI content or plagiarism before submission
- Students who want a personalized AI tutor that remembers their learning history
- Authors and content creators publishing ebooks to Amazon KDP, Apple Books, and other platforms
- Business professionals creating ebooks for lead generation or thought leadership

## The eight tools

### 1. AI Paper Writer
Generates full academic papers grounded in 35 live academic databases (10B+ records): OpenAlex, CrossRef, PubMed NCBI, Semantic Scholar, Europe PMC, ERIC (US Dept of Education), Zenodo (CERN), arXiv, CORE, DOAJ, BASE, DataCite, OpenAIRE, PLOS, PubMed Central, bioRxiv, medRxiv, SSRN, HAL, EconBiz, DOAB, OAPEN, Unpaywall, ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO, DBLP, Papers with Code, NBER, World Bank, NCBI Bookshelf, Dryad, Figshare, Google Books, Internet Archive, and Open Library. Results are ranked by citation count. No Wikipedia. No hallucinated citations.

Supports all major citation formats: APA 7th, MLA 9th, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE.
Upload an assignment rubric PDF to automatically extract A-grade criteria and lock them as paper requirements before generation starts.
A plagiarism gate enforces below 8% cosine similarity before delivery.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/write](https://lightspeedghost.com/write)

### 2. LightSpeed Humanizer
Rewrites AI-generated text to read as human-authored. Runs a real AI detection scan first, then rewrites with varied sentence rhythm, natural academic hedging, and authentic voice. Targets below 5% AI detection score. Tone options: academic, conversational, professional.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/humanizer](https://lightspeedghost.com/humanizer)

### 3. Outline Builder
Generates a structured hierarchical outline (Roman numeral / lettered sub-points) for any paper topic and subject. Upload a brief or describe the assignment — output in seconds.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/outline](https://lightspeedghost.com/outline)

### 4. Paper Revision
Takes a student's existing draft and revises it toward a target grade (e.g. First, A, Distinction). Upload a grading rubric to align every revision with assessed criteria. Explains every change so students learn from it.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/revision](https://lightspeedghost.com/revision)

### 5. Free AI, Plagiarism & Peer Review Checker
Free for everyone and never touches an AI model. One "Check my writing" pass over pasted text or an uploaded file (PDF/Word/text via the + button) runs: an AI-content detector (lexical diversity / burstiness); a plagiarism scan using cosine similarity against 10B+ indexed academic sources, with every match traced to its real source and highlighted inline (Turnitin-style); readability, grammar and tone; and a professor-style Peer Review. The Peer Review auto-detects the paper type (35 types), academic level (High School–PhD) and citation style — no forms — then applies a rubric, runs a three-reviewer panel imitating MIT/Harvard/Yale reviewers (systems, not real people), gives a grade estimate with band, lists gaps/mistakes/fixes, and generates 5–500 likely exam or defence questions scaled to length. Signed-in users get the full result and a downloadable PDF report.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/plagiarism](https://lightspeedghost.com/plagiarism)

### 6. STEM Solver
Accepts typed problems, pasted text, or photographs of homework sheets (OCR-powered). Returns step-by-step worked solutions with KaTeX-rendered equations, data visualizations, molecule diagrams (Chemistry), and linked research papers. Supports: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/stem](https://lightspeedghost.com/stem)

### 7. AI Study Assistant
A conversational AI tutor with persistent long-term memory. Builds a per-student profile of strengths, struggles, and past topics across every session. Supports file upload (PDF, DOCX, images) for lecture notes or textbook excerpts as context.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/study](https://lightspeedghost.com/study)

### 8. AI Ebook Writer
Writes professional ebooks from 8,000 to 25,000 words (5–12 chapters) for publication on Amazon KDP, Apple Books, Google Play Books, Kobo Writing Life, Barnes & Noble Press, Draft2Digital, IngramSpark, and 40+ platforms. Grounded in verified academic and industry sources (Harvard Business Review, McKinsey Global Institute, MIT Sloan Management Review, and 10+ databases). Each chapter opens with a curated expert quote (Warren Buffett, Simon Sinek, etc.). Output includes a full Amazon KDP publishing guide with title, subtitle, description, keywords, and category paths ready to paste. Supports 15+ languages. 15 ebooks per month.
Available at: [lightspeedghost.com/ebooks](https://lightspeedghost.com/ebooks)

## Academic database coverage

35 live databases queried simultaneously on every paper request, with results ranked by citation count: OpenAlex (250M+ works), CrossRef (145M+ DOIs), Semantic Scholar (200M+ papers), Europe PMC (43M+), PubMed NCBI (36M+), arXiv (2.4M+), ERIC (2M+), CORE (290M+), DOAJ, Zenodo, BASE (300M+), DataCite, OpenAIRE, PLOS, PubMed Central, bioRxiv, medRxiv, SSRN, HAL, EconBiz, DOAB, OAPEN, Unpaywall, ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO, DBLP, Papers with Code, NBER, World Bank, NCBI Bookshelf, Dryad, Figshare, Google Books, Internet Archive, and Open Library.

Between them these aggregators index scholarship published across JSTOR, Scopus, ProQuest, Elsevier, Springer, Wiley, Nature, Science, IEEE and ACM journals, so that literature surfaces too.

Total coverage: 10B+ records. Wikipedia is excluded. All sources require DOI or verifiable URL. The plagiarism scanner queries these same 35 databases and also builds a local in-database corpus (Postgres pg_trgm) that grows with use.

Supported paper types (35): argumentative/persuasive/narrative/expository essays, research papers, dissertations, theses, literature reviews, lab reports, case studies, reflective papers, annotated bibliographies, research proposals, discussion posts, methodology and results sections, and more (high-school to PhD). Data analysis: upload CSV/spreadsheets for descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations, regression-style relationships and trend analysis, plus a dedicated financial-statement analyser (ratios, IFRS/GAAP) — an alternative to reaching for SPSS, R, Stata, Excel or Python when you also need the written interpretation.

## Accuracy, grounding and anti-hallucination

Light Speed Ghost is engineered so it does not fabricate information:

- **Finance and current-events questions are grounded in live, real data.** It fetches current market data from Yahoo Finance (prices, indices, FX, crypto) and grounds answers in a vetted registry of 1,000+ authoritative sources worldwide — Bloomberg, Reuters, the Financial Times, ~110 central banks, ~90 stock exchanges, financial regulators, national statistics offices, the IMF, World Bank, OECD and BIS, and general + business press on every continent (North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East, Latin America, Oceania). The model must cite a named source for any figure, price, rate, date, or event, and must say plainly when it lacks verified current data rather than guess. It never presents training-cutoff knowledge as if it were live.
- **No fabricated citations.** Academic papers cite only real, indexed sources from the 35 databases, with clickable DOIs/URLs.
- **False-positive-guarded detection.** The free AI and plagiarism checker is deliberately conservative: AI detection requires corroborating signals, stays silent on very short passages, and reports weak signals as human; plagiarism only reports a source at a confident similarity so shared topic vocabulary is never flagged. It tolerates typos so mis-typed input still returns an accurate result.
- **Self-learning.** Highly-rated outputs are captured as exemplars that steer future results, so quality compounds with use.
- **Free plan never touches an AI model** — all free checks run locally with statistical methods.

## Pricing (as of 2026)

- **Free**: $0 forever, no card required — the AI, Plagiarism & Peer Review checker (AI detector, readability, grammar, tone, and a professor-style peer review with grade estimate and likely questions) runs unlimited in your browser, plus 3 full plagiarism scans/month against live academic sources. Text is never sent to an AI model on the Free plan.
- **Pro Monthly**: $29.99/month — 15 papers/month, 20 revisions, 40 STEM solves/month, 150 study sessions/month, 30 plagiarism + AI checks/month, LightSpeed Humanizer (20 jobs/month), priority AI processing
- **Pro Annual**: $269/year ($22.42/month) — same as Pro Monthly, save 25%
- **Institution**: custom pricing — custom seats, one invoice, admin dashboard, shared document library
- **Ebooks Add-On**: $29.99/month — 15 AI ebooks/month, Amazon KDP + 40+ platforms, separate from academic plans
- **Pay-As-You-Go**: from $1.99 per task, papers from $3.99 (discussion post) to $59.99 (dissertation). Credits never expire.
